```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(CellChat)

save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE, svg = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  if (svg) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".svg"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}
```

# Coculture targets upset plot.
```{r}
# Geneformer significant and negative shift means inhibition moves towards controls.
tet2_geneformer_results = read_csv("input_data/geneformer_results/hpb2022_tet2_control_monos_perturb_output_stats.csv")
dnmt3a_geneformer_results = read_csv("input_data/geneformer_results/hpb2022_d3a_control_monos_perturb_output_stats_12L.csv")

# DE significant upregulated genes have potential of moving towards controls if inhibited. -> CHANGE TO CELLCHAT
cellchat_pathway_results = read_tsv("tables/cellchat/mono_endo_ranknet_results.tsv")
tet2_significance = read_tsv("tables/cellchat/tet2_ranknet_results.tsv")
dnmt3a_significance = read_tsv("tables/cellchat/dnmt3a_ranknet_results.tsv")
ligands_and_receptors = CellChatDB.human$interaction


# Get TET2 CellChat candidates.
tet2_candidate_pathways = tet2_significance %>%
  select(-c(contribution, contribution.relative.1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = contribution.scaled) %>%
  filter(pvalues < 0.05, TET2 > Control)

tet2_lrs = left_join(tet2_candidate_pathways, ligands_and_receptors, by = c(name = "pathway_name")) %>%
  select(ligand, receptor)

tet2_candidate_genes = c(tet2_lrs$ligand, tet2_lrs$receptor) %>% 
  strsplit("_") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

# Get DNMT3A CellChat candidates.
dnmt3a_candidate_pathways = dnmt3a_significance %>%
  select(-c(contribution, contribution.relative.1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = contribution.scaled) %>%
  filter(pvalues < 0.05, DNMT3A > Control)

dnmt3a_lrs = left_join(dnmt3a_candidate_pathways, ligands_and_receptors, by = c(name = "pathway_name")) %>%
  select(ligand, receptor)

dnmt3a_candidate_genes = c(dnmt3a_lrs$ligand, dnmt3a_lrs$receptor) %>% 
  strsplit("_") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

# Get Geneformer candidates.
tet2_geneformer_targets = tet2_geneformer_results %>%
  filter(Shift_to_goal_end < 0 & Sig == 1) %>%
  pull(Gene_name)

dnmt3a_geneformer_targets = dnmt3a_geneformer_results %>%
  filter(Shift_to_goal_end < 0 & Sig == 1) %>%
  pull(Gene_name)



```


```{r}
library(UpSetR)
library(reshape2)

gene_lists = list(TET2_Geneformer = tet2_geneformer_targets, DNMT3A_Geneformer = dnmt3a_geneformer_targets, TET2_CellChat = tet2_candidate_genes, DNMT3A_CellChat = dnmt3a_candidate_genes)
gene_df = melt(gene_lists)
colnames(gene_df) = c("Gene", "List")
(target_plot = upset(fromList(gene_lists), order.by = "freq", scale.intersections = "log10", show.numbers = FALSE))

svg("figures/upset/perturbation_candidates.svg", height = 4, width = 5)
target_plot
dev.off()


refined_gene_lists = list(TET2_Geneformer = c("CXCL3", "CXCL2", "FTH1", "JUN", "HLA-DRA", "CXCR4", "AQP9", "BCL2A1", "S100A8", "DNAJC21", "ICAM1"), TET2_CellChat = tet2_candidate_genes)
refined_gene_df = melt(refined_gene_lists)
colnames(refined_gene_df) = c("Gene", "List")
(refined_target_plot = upset(fromList(refined_gene_lists), order.by = "freq", show.numbers = FALSE))

svg("figures/upset/refined_candidates.svg", height = 3, width = 5)
refined_target_plot
dev.off()
```

```{r}
df2 <- data.frame(gene=unique(unlist(gene_lists)))

df1 <- lapply(gene_lists, function(x){ data.frame(gene = x) }) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "path")

df_int <- lapply(df2$gene,function(x){
  # pull the name of the intersections
  intersection <- df1 %>% 
    dplyr::filter(gene==x) %>% 
    arrange(path) %>% 
    pull("path") %>% 
    paste0(collapse = "|")
  
  # build the dataframe
  data.frame(gene = x,int = intersection)
}) %>% 
  bind_rows()

head(df_int,n=20)

df_int %>% 
  group_by(int) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))


```



```{r}
myeloid_merged_obj = readRDS("../Scale/rds_objects/11562-JVA/2_myeloid_merged_obj.rds")

# Get the identities of each cell (e.g., clusters or cell types)
Idents(myeloid_merged_obj) = "Set"
cell_identities <- Idents(myeloid_merged_obj)

# Initialize a list to store the percentages
percentage_cells_expressing_kdr <- list()

kdr_expression <- GetAssayData(object = myeloid_merged_obj, slot = "data")["KDR", ]

# Loop through each unique identity
for (identity in unique(cell_identities)) {
  # Get the cells belonging to the current identity
  cells_in_identity <- WhichCells(myeloid_merged_obj, idents = identity)
  
  # Calculate the number of cells expressing KDR in the current identity
  num_cells_expressing_kdr <- sum(kdr_expression[cells_in_identity] > 0)
  
  # Calculate the total number of cells in the current identity
  total_cells_in_identity <- length(cells_in_identity)
  
  # Calculate the percentage of cells expressing KDR
  percentage <- (num_cells_expressing_kdr / total_cells_in_identity) * 100
  
  # Store the percentage in the list
  percentage_cells_expressing_kdr[[identity]] <- percentage
}

# Convert the list to a data frame for easier viewing
percentage_cells_expressing_kdr_df <- as.data.frame(percentage_cells_expressing_kdr)
```

```{r}
myeloid_merged_obj = readRDS("../Scale/rds_objects/11562-JVA/2_myeloid_merged_obj.rds")

myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type[myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type == "LMPP"] = "Lympho-myeloid primed progenitor cells"
myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type[myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type == "MEP"] = "Megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor cells"
myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type[myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type == "MPP"] = "Multipotent progenitor cells"

myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type[myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type == "dendritic"] = "Dendritic cells"

myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type[myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type == "neutrophil"] = "Neutrophils"
myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type[myeloid_merged_obj$cell_type == "platelet"] = "Platelets"

epc_proportion_data = myeloid_merged_obj@meta.data %>% 
  filter(Set %in% c("MPP-AAVS", "MPP-TET2"))
epc_proportion_data$CRISPR_target[epc_proportion_data$CRISPR_target == "AAVS"] = "Control"

colors = c("#FEB5A2FF", "#466F9DFF", "#9D7660FF",  "#7B5A56FF",  "#D7B5A6FF",  "#B88A72FF", "#C4A494FF", "#C8133BFF", "#D08A8AFF", "#A3B18AFF", "#A37A93FF")

(epc_proportion_bar = ggplot(epc_proportion_data, aes(x = CRISPR_target, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  xlab("") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend("")))
save_plot(epc_proportion_bar, "figures/bars/epc_proportion_bar", width = 4.5, height = 3, svg = TRUE)
```

```{r}
epc_proportion_data_for_table = epc_proportion_data %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, CRISPR_target) %>%
  dplyr::rename(group = "CRISPR_target") %>%
  group_by(group, cell_type) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(count),
         proportion = count / total_count) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-total_count)  # Remove the total_count column if not needed
write_tsv(epc_proportion_data_for_table, "tables/epc/hsc_derived_proportions.tsv")
```

```{r}
#devtools::install_github("rpolicastro/scProportionTest")
library(scProportionTest)

epc_proportion_seu = subset(myeloid_merged_obj, subset = Set %in% c("MPP-AAVS", "MPP-TET2"))
epc_proportion_seu$CRISPR_target[epc_proportion_seu$CRISPR_target == "AAVS"] = "Control"
prop_test = sc_utils(epc_proportion_seu)

prop_test_tet2 = permutation_test(
  prop_test, cluster_identity = "cell_type",
  sample_1 = "Control", sample_2 = "TET2",
  sample_identity = "CRISPR_target")
permutation_plot(prop_test_tet2)

write_tsv(prop_test_tet2@results %>% as.data.frame(), "tables/epc/hsc_derived_proportions_significance.tsv")

```

# Pre-geneformer umap.
```{r}
library(harmony)

diet_seurat_trimmed = readRDS("../Single_Cell_CHIP/rds_objects/diet_seurat_trimmed.rds")

veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control = subset(diet_seurat_trimmed, subset = cell_type == "CD14 Monos" & GROUP %in% c("TET2 VEH", "none VEH"))
veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap = veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:10) %>%
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "ProjectID", nclust = 1)

veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap$GROUP[veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap$GROUP == "TET2 VEH"] = "TET2"
veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap$GROUP[veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap$GROUP == "none VEH"] = "Control"
veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap$GROUP = factor(veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap$GROUP, levels = c("TET2", "Control"))

(tet2_cd14_monocytes_rna_umap = DimPlot(veh_cd14_monos_tet2_control_umap, reduction = "harmony", group.by = "GROUP", pt.size = 0.01, cols = c("#3E7274", "grey")) +
    ggtitle("RNA CD14+ monocyte embeddings") +
    theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank()) +
    xlab("UMAP 1") +
    ylab("UMAP 2"))

save_plot(tet2_cd14_monocytes_rna_umap, "figures/umaps/cd14_monos_rna", png = TRUE)
```
